reason: I'd love someone to just handle it all, but a company in Kuwait with no past clients, no UK office and half the money up front by PayPal is too much of a gamble for me. Plus 'tell them what you need' and 'approve the design' sounds like I'm still the one writing the content and chasing it.
objection: If it goes wrong I've paid half to someone abroad I can't visit and can't look up any reviews for, and I still don't have time to write all the words and answer their questions.
would_change_my_mind: A few real UK clients I could ring or see reviews from, plus them writing all the content for me from one short call, and letting me pay by bank transfer with less up front.
